answer: Clone-cost design: bind each identity to a device-unique hardware root plus a 25-POA locked bond. Re-registering the same root under a new key is detected within 2 epochs and both stakes are forfeited. A mesa of spare accounts cannot share one machine; attackers must buy distinct devices and post 25 POA per fake. forge-scoped audits re-challenge 10% of roots each epoch, and velvet standing decays after 6 epochs without honest graded work.
